method.purpose: Single outstanding verified complete CON reads on loopback. Whole-process CPU totals cover user and kernel execution in the measurement gate. Latencies are client active-operation times.
method.comparison: Adjacent windows alternate arm order AB/BA by pass. Pools, runtime and verifying client match within each campaign. Pooled latency includes every complete pair, including guard failures. Rates must each be within 0.5% of 800 and of each other, missed starts at most 0.1%, p50 increase at most 2 us and p99 at most 10 us; CPU floor 20 15.625ms ticks in both processes.
method.profile: Per-poll thread cycles and monotonic wall time. The pending-to-next-poll gap includes reactor and scheduling delays and excludes canceled futures. Two snapshots at 128 and 2176 completed sends. Empty timestamp pair and same-executable off/on measurements bound observed overhead.
method.history_scope: Embedded ReadyUdp in companion eea0374; both history arms use its async App fixture. This tests project core history independently of tools/coaptic-tokio.

issues: Historical 16,000-operation 4,096-byte request refused before startup by the 60,000-datagram harness bound. Both blockwise arms ran 14,400 measured operations plus 32 warmups.

Common poll_recv_from patch rejected at source review. Tokio monitors READABLE | ERROR in recv_from; poll_read_io uses the read-direction mask. Measured candidate is Windows-only, where Mio 1.2.4 includes POLL_CONNECT_FAIL in readable events.
